name_zh: 麦加利银行大楼（外滩18号）
axes: GLB X east, Y up, Z south
geometry_detail: two profiled round Ionic columns with 3D spiral volutes
deep three-bay portico and separate recessed glass/frame meshes
five open ground bays and decorated two-leaf doorway
side French windows, projecting balconies, iron railings and triangular pediments
attic slit windows and radial carved fan panels
layered cornices, individual modillions and dentils
roof terrace railing and setback pediment pavilion
perforated side/rear shells and interior floor slabs
evidence_limits: front proportions derived from photograph, not a measured elevation
side/rear and rooftop depth are simplified because reference photographs do not document them
small sculptural motifs are geometric interpretations
existing OSM footprint uses current surveyed/mapped outline; its precision is not certified

reference_photo.author: ScareCriterion12
reference_photo.scope: Selected lower front stone faces and six independently mapped main glass rectangles

geometry_authoring: Original photo-proportioned 3D reconstruction with selective photographic stone/window appearance; not photogrammetry. Frames, columns, roof and side/rear remain geometric materials.
current_detail_note: 柱距、窗宽和主窗分格按2021照片比例校正；部分下部石墙及六块主窗使用原照片，保留真正窗洞和独立窗框。新增连续墙芯修复石块间贯通空缝，保留石缝边界；18mm灰缝退距、颜色及未见侧后仍含推定。不是摄影测量，贴图保留原照片光照。

wall_core_repair.method: Two conforming continuous backing solids; no internal sides between occupied wall cells; original stone/window/photo surfaces unchanged.
wall_core_repair.visual_limit: Stone-joint boundaries remain; the repair removes unintended see-through gaps, not every thin grid line.
